notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Aphetto Alchemist and any other creature you control.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.
